title: AdvancedTPA
description: /spawn /afk /tpa to your minecraft server. used and created by 4dupe.
body:
AdvancedTPA is a powerful and highly configurable teleportation plugin designed to improve player mobility, convenience, and server management on Minecraft servers. It provides a complete teleportation experience with an advanced TPA system, allowing players to send, accept, deny, cancel, and automatically accept teleport requests through simple, intuitive commands.

Beyond standard player-to-player teleportation, AdvancedTPA includes fully customizable `/spawn` and `/afk` commands, enabling players to quickly travel to important server locations. Teleports can be protected with configurable warmup delays, cooldowns, and movement cancellation to prevent abuse while maintaining balanced gameplay. Actionbar countdowns, chat notifications, and sound effects keep players informed throughout the teleport process for a polished user experience.

The plugin also includes intelligent safety features such as teleport ban protection, ensuring players cannot teleport into restricted or protected areas. Server administrators can easily configure global Spawn and AFK Pool locations, manage permission-based access for every command, and customize virtually every aspect of the plugin through an easy-to-edit configuration file.

Every message, prefix, cooldown, delay, permission, and setting is fully configurable, allowing AdvancedTPA to seamlessly fit any server style—from casual SMPs and community servers to competitive LifeSteal, Survival, and PvP networks. Built with performance and reliability in mind, AdvancedTPA offers a clean, modern teleportation system that enhances the overall player experience while remaining lightweight, flexible, and easy to manage.
